title: 第七章 禽兽不如第八章 惊慌失措的聂星辰
content_zh:
“赵远方？”
聂星辰转头看去，看到了来人眉头一皱。
“你前老板？”
姜辰是第一次见到赵远方，和电视剧的不同，这个赵远方比较的文雅。
“是的。”聂星辰点点头。
“聂星辰，真的是你？”赵远方走了过来，目光看到姜辰的时候，脸色微微的一沉。
“你也在这里吃饭吗？”聂星辰问道。
“是啊，我……”赵远方刚想说什么，突然改口道：“聂星辰，我们借一步说话。”
聂星辰看了姜辰一眼。
“去吧。”姜辰道。
“我们去外面吧。”
聂星辰站了起来，和赵远方离开了。
“赵远方？”
姜辰笑了笑，如果出现在这里的是严景致，说不定他还有些担心，但出现在这里的人是赵远方，他根本就不需要担心。
现在姜辰关心的是如何的遇到那些影视剧中的女主角，毕竟，只有在她们的身上才能签到。
现在君悦府买了房子，以后一定能够遇到顾佳和钟晓芹的，所以，这两个人就不需要担心啦，而安家天下的房似锦，现在因为不知道来了没有，不过，只要关注王子健，以后就能够见到房似锦。
至于其他人，现在也不知道这个世界融合了多少的影视剧，所以，只能看运气。
另外，就是关于签到。
现在签到得到了金融投资精通，过目不忘和高级车技。
金融投资精通不用说，他之所以有现在的财富，就是靠了它。过目不忘已经签到了一个月啦，在这一个月内，他也享受到了过目不忘带来的好处。

不过，这高级车技似乎用处不大。他的两世加起来差不多已经五十多岁了，不可能和那些小年轻一样去赛车的。
……
餐厅外。
“聂星辰，里面的那个人是你男朋友？你什么时候交男朋友了？我怎么不知道？”赵远方看着聂星辰说道：“我虽然不是你的老板了，但我还是你的朋友，作为你的朋友，关心你一下应该没问题吧？”
“他是我老板，不是我男朋友。”聂星辰摇摇头说道。
“不是你男朋友你就出来和他一起吃饭？你就不担心他对你怎么样？”赵远方道。
“赵总，当初在你的公司，我和你一起吃饭的次数不少吧？”聂星辰没好气的说道。
“他能够和我相比吗？”
赵远方说道：“不过，我知道你从铂爵集团辞职，到是很惊讶的。虽然知道你不喜欢在严景致手下工作，但也没想到你会走的这么的干脆。”
“赵总，你找我不是想说这些无关紧要的事吧？”聂星辰比任何人都要了解赵远方。
“我受人之托，让你返回铂爵集团上班。”赵远方尴尬的笑了笑后说道。
“是严景致让你来的吧？你回去告诉他，这是不可能的。”聂星辰说完转身进入了餐厅。
赵远方愣愣的看着聂星辰进入餐厅。
好一会儿，他才反应过来，拿起手机，拨通了一个号码：“严总啊，我见到聂星辰了，不过，她似乎对返回铂爵集团工作没兴趣。”
……
聂星辰回到座位上，看到姜辰看着手机微笑着，就开口问道：“姜总，你在看什么呢？这么的开心？”
“哦，我在看娱乐新闻。新闻上说大明星甄念要回国了。我听说她是铂爵集团总裁严景致的未婚妻，不知道是不是真的？”姜辰知道的电视剧中，甄念就是这么的对聂星辰说的。
content_en:
"Zhao Yuanfang?"
Nie Xingchen turned around and saw the visitor frowning.
"Your former boss?"
This was the first time Jiang Chen met Zhao Yuanfang. Different from the one in the TV series, this Zhao Yuanfang was more elegant.
"Yes." Nie Xingchen nodded.
"Nie Xingchen, is it really you?" Zhao Yuanfang walked over, and when he saw Jiang Chen, his face sank slightly.
"Are you eating here too?" Nie Xingchen asked.
"Yeah, I..." Zhao Yuanfang was about to say something, but suddenly changed his words: "Nie Xingchen, let's take a step to talk."
Nie Xingchen glanced at Jiang Chen.
"Go." Jiang Chen said.
"Let's go outside."
Nie Xingchen stood up and left with Zhao Yuanfang.
"Zhao Yuanfang?"
Jiang Chen smiled. If the person who appeared here was Yan Jingzhi, he might still be a little worried, but the person who appeared here was Zhao Yuanfang, so he didn't need to worry at all.
Now Jiang Chen is concerned about how to meet the heroines in movies and TV series. After all, he can only sign in with them.
Now that I have bought a house in Junyue Mansion, I will definitely meet Gu Jia and Zhong Xiaoqin in the future, so these two people don't need to worry. As for An Jia Tianxia's Fang Sijin, I don't know if he is here now, but as long as he pays attention to Wang Zijian, he will be able to meet Fang Sijin in the future.
As for others, I don’t know how many movies and TV series this world has integrated, so they can only depend on luck.
Also, it’s about signing in.
Signing in now gives you financial investment proficiency, photographic memory and advanced driving skills.
Needless to say, he is proficient in financial investment. The reason why he has his current wealth is due to it. Photographic memory has been signed in for a month, and within this month, he has also enjoyed the benefits of photographic memory.
However, this advanced driving skill seems to be of little use. In his two lives combined, he is almost fifty years old, and it is impossible for him to go racing like those young people.
…
Outside the restaurant.
"Nie Xingchen, that person inside is your boyfriend? When did you have a boyfriend? Why didn't I know?" Zhao Yuanfang looked at Nie Xingchen and said, "Although I am no longer your boss, I am still your friend. As your friend, it should be okay to care about you, right?"
"He is my boss, not my boyfriend." Nie Xingchen shook his head and said.
"If he's not your boyfriend, why don't you go out to have dinner with him? Aren't you worried about what he will do to you?" Zhao Yuanfang said.
"Mr. Zhao, when I was in your company, I had dinner with you a lot, right?" Nie Xingchen said angrily.
"Can he compare to me?"
Zhao Yuanfang said: "However, I was surprised to know that you resigned from Bojue Group. Although I knew you didn't like working under Yan Jingzhi, I didn't expect you to leave so simply."
"Mr. Zhao, you didn't come to me to talk about these irrelevant things, did you?" Nie Xingchen knows Zhao Yuanfang better than anyone else.
"I was entrusted by someone to ask you to return to work at Bojue Group." Zhao Yuanfang smiled awkwardly and said.
"Yan Jingzhi asked you to come, right? Go back and tell him that this is impossible." After speaking, Nie Xingchen turned and entered the restaurant.
Zhao Yuanfang watched Nie Xingchen enter the restaurant blankly.
After a while, he realized what he was doing. He picked up his phone and dialed a number: "Mr. Yan, I saw Nie Xingchen, but she doesn't seem to be interested in returning to work at Bojue Group."
…
Nie Xingchen returned to his seat and saw Jiang Chen smiling while looking at his phone, so he asked: "Mr. Jiang, what are you looking at? Are you so happy?"
"Oh, I was watching the entertainment news. The news said that the big star Zhen Nian is returning to China. I heard that she is the fiancée of Yan Jingzhi, the president of the Platinum Jue Group. I wonder if it is true?" In the TV series Jiang Chen knew, this is what Zhen Nian said to Nie Xingchen.
